events.title: Firefox 54 enables multi-process for all
events.summary: Mozilla released Firefox 54 on June 13, 2017 — enabling Electrolysis (e10s) multi-process architecture for all users by default.
events.about: Firefox e10s isolated tabs into separate processes — a tab crash no longer took down the whole browser. Firefox 54 completed the years-long Electrolysis project, closing the stability gap with Chrome before Quantum arrived in version 57.

narrative.whyChosen: Firefox 54 was the e10s milestone that made Firefox multiprocess like Chrome.
narrative.whyImportant: Process isolation improved security and stability for hundreds of millions of users.
narrative.problemSolved: Single-process Firefox meant one heavy page or plugin crash killed every open tab.
